Temple, TX Home for Sale | Kiella-Built with Air-Conditioned Garage! #texasrealestate 

Welcome to 816 Killam Dr, a move-in ready 3 bed | 2 bath home on a spacious corner lot in the desirable Hartrick Ranch subdivision!

This Kiella-built home offers:
✅ Open-concept floor plan with quartz countertops
✅ Split-bedroom layout for added privacy
✅ Beautiful landscaping & curb appeal
✅ Air-conditioned garage—perfect for a year-round workshop or hobby space
✅ Located in Academy ISD, close to Baylor Scott & White, the VA Hospital, and even an easy commute to Austin-area employers like Samsung

This home blends comfort, convenience, and location in one package. 🏡
